1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The Application stands disposed of.

3. First Bail Application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as 'B.N.S.S.') (earlier Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973),
has been filed on behalf of the Petitioner, for grant of Anticipatory Bail in FIR No. 378/2025 under Section 376/384/120B/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Prashant Vihar, North.
4.
On advance Notice, learned APP has appeared and seeks time to file a Status Report.
5. Let the Status Report be filed within three weeks with copy to the opposite counsel.
